titulo.alumno:
«Глаголы совершенного и несовершенного вида»
Verb aspect pairs

intro: Many verbs are learned in pairs: читать / прочитать. The imperfective presents the process or repetition; the perfective, a bounded action.

piezas.titulo: Many verbs are learned in pairs: читать / прочитать. The imperfective presents the process or repetition; the perfective, a bounded action.
texto: Many verbs are learned in pairs: читать / прочитать. The imperfective presents the process or repetition; the perfective, a bounded action.
A prefix can change the lexical meaning, so learn frequent pairs in context rather than adding any prefix.

frases.alumno: I want to read this article all the way through.
She likes reading before going to sleep.

pregunta.texto: Which verb presents the reading as completed?

opciones.explicacion: Прочитать presents the reading as a bounded or finished action.
This form does not express the relation the question asks about.
Check which word governs the case or the structure.

pregunta.texto: What does this phrase mean? «Я хочу прочитать эту статью.»

opciones.texto: I want to read this article all the way through.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: She likes reading before going to sleep.
opciones.explicacion: That is the translation of the second example.

piezas.traduccion: She likes reading before going to sleep.
piezas.explicacion: Pay attention to the order of the words and to the grammatical form highlighted.
